name: Why does my house smell like sewage?

mainEntity.name: Why does my house smell like sewage?

acceptedAnswer.text: A sewage smell in your house often indicates a problem with your plumbing or sewage system. Common causes include a dry P-trap, which allows sewer gases to escape, a blocked or damaged vent pipe, a leaky drain pipe, or an issue with your septic tank or municipal sewer line. Sometimes, a sewer backup or burst pipe can also cause a strong sewage odor. Identifying the exact source is crucial for effective remediation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Sewage smell usually points to plumbing issues like a dry P-trap, blocked vent pipe, or leaky drain, allowing sewer gases to enter your home.
